call.sequence_note: Terminated deliberately after about nine minutes and rebooked. The prospect took the call outdoors while taking his children to a creek, and the rep judged the setting unworkable for a full discovery conversation and moved it to Monday 11am. No pitch, no price and no baseline were reached.

rep.name: Michael Brideau
rep.location: Medellín, Colombia; previously four years in Scottsdale, Arizona

setter.name: Kim Forbes-Sobers
setter.evidence: Named directly by the prospect, the only such confirmation in this batch: 'Who did you chat with? Was it Kim, or who did you talk to?' — 'Kim, I believe, yeah.' Note that the file title carries no KFS suffix despite this being one of Kim's sets.

prospect.name: John Williamson
prospect.location: Camp Verde, Arizona, USA — about 25 minutes from Sedona
prospect.occupation: Works from home, with most of the work done from his phone. Nature of the work not established.
prospect.family_status: Sole custodian of two children, roughly five and seven, since the younger was six weeks old. They are with him five days a week and with their mother on Mondays and Tuesdays.
prospect.training_background: Formerly an avid mountain biker, then roughly five years of nothing while raising an infant alone. Bought a new mountain bike about a year ago and started riding hard, along with isolation dumbbell work he found visually effective but unsatisfying — 'that was isolating things and just working out things to get a pump. It gets visual results, but I don't know, I wasn't feeling any better.' Has been doing kettlebell exercises for a couple of months and knows a few basic movements. Paddleboards with his children.

signals: Lost ground across a hard season rather than to illness — five years of single-handed childcare during which he stopped doing what he loved: 'I stopped doing a lot of the things that I liked doing and stopped getting out there because I was constantly taking care of an infant'
Explicitly framed as reclaiming a former self: 'now they're getting bigger and they're getting a hell of a lot more capable and actually able to get back to myself'

A single vivid trigger moment with regret attached, from August last year: 'carrying a four-year-old and a six-year-old and a couple of things from the car, carrying them upstairs, I got up there and I was like, holy, I'm like, winded... and I've got them five days a week, and I can hardly even carry them up the stairs'

Confidence held at 0.7 rather than higher because the call ran nine minutes and was rescheduled before baseline — no age, height, weight, occupation, income or medical information exists to test the assignment against

goals.text: An actual structured plan for hitting new muscle groups rather than improvising
Dietary structure — he currently eats roughly one meal a day and does not know whether that is harming him
New kettlebell complexes and ideas beyond the few basics he knows
Be able to carry both his children upstairs without being winded, and keep up with them as they get more capable
Get back to himself and to mountain biking after five years away from it
Feel better rather than just look better — isolation work gave him visual results without the feeling

pains.text: Became winded carrying his two children upstairs, which he describes as the wake-up call
Five years of doing nothing while raising an infant alone and working
Eats very little, essentially one meal a day with his children, and his father has told him this is harming his metabolism — 'honestly, I don't know the truth of it'
Training without structure or progression, working muscles in isolation for a pump without feeling any better
Sole custody five days a week, which constrains when he can do anything for himself

evidence: No offer was made and no price was mentioned. The call was ended deliberately by the rep and rebooked.
Rebooked on the call with a specific time and an updated invite sent live: 'Can you do 11 a.m. Monday?' — 'Yeah, I' — 'Perfect. Okay, cool. I'm going to update the calendar invite for you.'
Confirmation arranged: 'I'll have Kim text you either Sunday or Monday morning just to confirm that time still works.'
Prospect was cooperative and unbothered by the reschedule: 'Awesome. Cool. appreciate it.'

Counter-evidence on the quality of the booking: the prospect had been led to expect something quite different — 'earlier when I talked to the last guy, he had said that this was like a 10 or 15 minute conversation' and 'he was saying that it was just a short call, ask questions, and get a basic plan set up.'
outcome.next_step: Full discovery call rebooked for Monday 2026-07-06 at 11:00 the prospect's time, with a calendar invite already updated and Kim to confirm on Sunday or Monday morning. The rep also undertook to check why the prospect had been told the call would be fifteen minutes.

notable.note: Two things, and the process point is to the rep's credit. First, he made the right call: six minutes in, with the prospect outdoors taking two young children to a creek, he stopped rather than running a compressed version of the process — 'we usually book off like a whole hour... especially with kids running around, like we're just not going to be able to have the depth of conversation that we need to.' That is exactly the discipline missing from several other calls in this batch and it should be recognised. Second, the reason the prospect was in that position is that the setter told him the call would take ten or fifteen minutes and would produce a basic plan. The rep did not paper over it — 'I'll check in with them, dude. Not sure why you said 15 minutes' — and undertook to follow it up. This file is also the only place in the batch where a prospect names the setter directly, confirming Kim Forbes-Sobers as KFS, and it shows Kim still performing set confirmations, which the manager was unsure about in his 1-1 the previous day.

quality.notes: Short file, heavily swapped. The rep's own questions repeatedly appear under 'john Williamson' — including 'Where are you calling in from?', 'What's motivating you to look for coaching now all of a sudden?' and 'Who did you chat with? Was it Kim?' — while the prospect's answers appear under the rep. Roles resolved from content: the rep is whoever asks questions, controls the calendar and offers to check in with the setter. Also worth noting that the prospect states he is on Pacific time, which is inconsistent with Camp Verde, Arizona; the booked time of '11 a.m. your time' may therefore be ambiguous.
